corrections.reason: The printed glyph in Col 2 L11 is clearly 6th-order 'ት' (ትሁሉት, archaic/dialectal Amharic 'ምን ትሁሉት ይላል' = what do you say he has become/gained for God?), where Stage 1 misread the cross-bar of ት as ተ.

corrections.old_text: ድ ፡ የብዕል ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ፍጻሜ ፡ እንደ ፡ ሆነ↵
corrections.corrected_text: ድ ፡ የብዕለ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ፍጻሜ ፡ እንደ ፡ ሆነ
corrections.reason: In Ge'ez construct state (ተጸውዖ), 'የብዕለ ሥጋ' parallels 'የብዕለ ነፍስ' on the very next line (L29); visually in Col 3 L28 the character is 1st-order 'ለ' (የብዕለ), not 6th-order 'ል'.

Both visually on the page (1st-order ሠ without the 6th-order hook) and grammatically modifying 'ኃጢአት' on the next line ('ወዶ በሠራው ኃጢአት ይፈተናል' = he is tempted by the sin that he willingly committed), the word is 'በሠራው', not 'በሥራው'.

Joined across L30-L31, the word is 'ሳይሠራ' (singular, matching 'ማንንም ማንን' and L27 'ኃጢአትን ሳይሠራ በመከራ አይፈትንምና'). Visually at the start of Col 4 L31 the glyph is 4th-order 'ራ', which Stage 1 misread as 'ሩ'.
